purpose: Resolve concrete governed packs affected by an already-authorized changed-path set without re-deciding CI control applicability and without executing pack validators.
resolution_invariants: Use repository-relative POSIX paths only; absolute, traversal, dot-segment, empty-segment and backslash paths fail closed.
DIRECT_CHILD resolves the first child below target_root and does not require the pack to still exist at head, so governed deletions remain visible.
ENUMERATE_CHILDREN discovers child directories dynamically from target_root; no pack slug allowlist is permitted.
Enumeration ignores hidden/underscore-prefixed children and symlinked directories but does not pre-judge pack structure; missing structure belongs to PACK_VALIDATION_EXECUTE_PACK_CHECKS.
Overlapping rules may legitimately resolve more than one affected pack class; deduplicate only identical pack_type plus pack_root identities.
A root-level file directly under profiles/ or skills/ is not invented into a pack.
No validator is executed by discovery.
No runtime, Git write, DB write, assurance, observability, EKB persistence, lifecycle, deployment or production authorization is emitted.
